text:
Alicia: heads-up — hitting a parity issue that caused duplicate provisioning during onboarding. node SDK retried a POST to /v1/provision and created two resources; curl/manual REST only shows one when replayed because we include an idempotency key there.

Priya: ouch. which SDK version?

Alicia: sdk@2.6.0, node18. repro:

```js
// using SDK
await client.provision.create({ teamId: 'onboard-123', config })
// -> succeeds, but server logs show two CreateProvision events ~200ms apart
```

Alicia: curl with explicit Idempotency-Key header:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/provision -H "Idempotency-Key: abc-123" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @payload.json
# -> single create event
```

Jamie: does SDK normally add an idempotency key when retrying a POST? I thought we had middleware for that.

Noor: historically SDK added a random Idempotency-Key for non-idempotent ops, but we removed it to avoid leaking keys across retries during redirects. maybe we regressed.

Priya: logs from staging show SDK made two POST attempts: first got a 502 from a noisy edge, second got 200. But neither request contained Idempotency-Key header. server treated them as two independent creates.

Alicia: exact log snippet: "POST /v1/provision -> 502 (gateway)", then "retrying request (no idem-key) -> 200 OK". server audit: two create events.

Jamie: thanks. sounds like SDK retry should either attach an idempotency key for safe retries of known-non-idempotent endpoints or avoid retrying unless caller opts in. we need parity with curl where callers explicitly set Idempotency-Key.

Noor: workaround for sample-app: set Idempotency-Key explicitly in headers for create calls. pushing patch now.

Priya: I'll open a ticket and PR: change default SDK behavior to 1) not auto-retry non-idempotent POSTs unless an Idempotency-Key is present, or 2) automatically generate and attach a per-call Idempotency-Key before the first attempt and reuse it for retries. leaning toward option 2 for DX but must ensure keys are stable across retries and logged.

Jamie: agree. option 2 is nicer for devs but security/audit must be clear. add a config flag `auto_idempotency=true|false`. Also expose the generated key on the response metadata so apps can correlate.

Alicia: PR skeleton: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/1299 (draft). I've added sample-app hotfix to explicitly set Idempotency-Key for now.

infra-bot: Created issue RED-5340: "SDK should generate/reuse Idempotency-Key for retried non-idempotent requests" and linked to pipeline 8021. Assigned @Jamie.

Jamie: plan: patch release 2.6.1 with opt-in auto_idempotency flag, tests for gateway 502 retry duplication, and migration note warning. full auto-on by default in 2.7.0 after rollout.

Priya: will add unit tests that simulate 502 then 200 and assert only one create action recorded when using auto_idempotency. also add an integration e2e that runs sample-app onboarding.

Alicia: thanks — sample-app hotfix deployed to staging. will monitor and follow up if duplicates continue. :thumbsup:
